name: skeleton
useFor: Use Skeleton in the shape of the content that is coming (lines of text, an avatar hexagon, a key) when it takes more than a moment to load. Size each block like the real content; clip it with ds-hex-mark or ds-hex for avatars and keys.
constraints: A skeleton for content that loads instantly
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its square frames and the hover wash (--panel)
title: Skeleton
description: A square block of the hover wash that breathes softly while content loads, and holds still with reduced motion.
